record.paper_title: OPEN QUESTIONS FOR OPERATORS RELATED TO RECTANGULAR CATALAN COMBINATORICS
record.context_brief: e-positivity at t = 1 + r for complete and hook seeds
record.original_question: For integers j,k with j + k = d - 1 and coprime integers a,b ≥ 1, let h^{(a,b)}_d(x;q,1+r) and s^{(a,b)}_(j|k)(x;q,1+r) be the specialized symmetric functions obtained from the corresponding seeds by the operators Θ_{a,b}. Using the order ≤_e for e-positivity, meaning that the difference has nonnegative coefficients in the elementary symmetric basis, can one prove both 0 ≤_e (-1)^(1-k) h^{(a,b)}_d(x;q,1+r) and q(-1)^j s^{(a,b)}_(j+1|k-1)(x;q,1+r) ≤_e (-1)^(j-1) s^{(a,b)}_(j|k)(x;q,1+r) for all such j,k,a,b?

evidence.quote: If f is e-positive, we write 0 ≤e f. This is clearly stronger than Schur-positivity, since it is classical that each eµ is itself Schur-positive.
Question.7. Can we prove that 0 ≤e (−1)1−kh(a,b)d (x; q, 1 + r), and q (−1)j s(a,b)(j+1 | k−1)(x; q, 1 + r) ≤e (−1)j−1 s(a,b)(j | k)(x; q, 1 + r), for all j + k = d − 1, and all coprime a, b ≥ 1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in the ring of symmetric functions over $\mathbb{Q}(q,t)$ with the standard bases $\{e_\lambda\}$ (elementary), $\{h_\lambda\}$ (complete homogeneous), and $\{s_\lambda\}$ (Schur). For coprime integers $a,b \ge 1$ and a positive integer $d$, let $\Theta_{a,b}$ denote the operator on symmetric functions associated with the rectangular $(a,b)$-Catalan setting (the relevant element of the elliptic Hall algebra acting on symmetric functions). Define the "complete seed" specialization 
$$h^{(a,b)}_d(x;q,t) := \Theta_{a,b}\bigl(h_d\bigr)(x;q,t),$$
and, for integers $j,k \ge 0$ with $j+k = d-1$, the "hook seed" specialization
$$s^{(a,b)}_{(j\mid k)}(x;q,t) := \Theta_{a,b}\bigl(s_{(j\mid k)}\bigr)(x;q,t),$$
where $(j\mid k)$ denotes the hook partition with arm $j$ and leg $k$ in Frobenius notation, namely $(j+1, 1^{k})$.

For symmetric functions $f,g$, write $f \le_e g$ to mean that $g - f$ is $e$-positive, i.e.\ all coefficients of $g-f$ in the elementary basis $\{e_\lambda\}$ are nonnegative; in particular $0 \le_e f$ means $f$ itself is $e$-positive.

Specialize $t = 1+r$, regarding $q$ and $r$ as formal parameters (so $e$-positivity is asked for as a polynomial in $q,r$ with nonnegative coefficients in the $e$-basis).

Prove or disprove: for every $d \ge 1$, every coprime pair $(a,b)$ with $a,b \ge 1$, and every $j,k \ge 0$ with $j+k = d-1$, both
$$0 \;\le_e\; (-1)^{1-k}\, h^{(a,b)}_d(x;q,1+r),$$
and
$$q\,(-1)^{j}\, s^{(a,b)}_{(j+1\mid k-1)}(x;q,1+r) \;\le_e\; (-1)^{j-1}\, s^{(a,b)}_{(j\mid k)}(x;q,1+r).$$
artifact.category_tag: Symmetric functions and rectangular Catalan combinatorics
artifact.status_search_result: The question is one of several positivity conjectures formulated for operators in the elliptic Hall algebra acting on symmetric functions (Theta operators, rectangular (a,b)-Catalan setting). Subsequent work by D'Adderio, Romero, and collaborators has resolved various Schur- and e-positivity conjectures in this circle, but no source found explicitly confirms a proof or disproof of the specific e-positivity / e-inclusion statements at t = 1+r for the complete and hook seeds for all coprime (a,b). Status appears unresolved in the literature accessible via the search.

status_evidence.title: Open Questions for operators related to Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: Formulates open positivity questions (Schur and e-positivity) for operators Θ_{a,b} acting on symmetric functions.
status_evidence.claim: The e-positivity question at t=1+r for complete and hook seeds is posed as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Symmetric Functions and Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics (2021 survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey by Bergeron updating the rectangular Catalan combinatorics framework and listing open positivity conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: The 2021 survey continues to discuss these positivity questions without indicating a complete resolution of the e-positivity at t=1+r for all coprime (a,b).
